title: 『オペレーション：エンジョイ縁日』

text_block_list.text: On the way home after spending the day out with Mihono Bourbon, we spot a festival at a nearby shrine.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Detecting that congestion is at five times normal levels. In other words, it is a huge turnout.
choice_data_list: Do you want to check it out?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No. I was merely scanning for which stalls have the highest customer density, as my data banks currently lack this information.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The yakisoba stall appears the most crowded. This is peculiar, considering it can be prepared at home.
Groooowl…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The visual input has stimulated my stomach, creating a natural bodily reflex.
choice_data_list: Let's get a closer look!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. If that is your desire, then I will accompany you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch… Gulp…
choice_data_list: How is it?
How is it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Delicious. The yakisoba is "piping hot," just as the stall's name suggests. However, it has a richer flavor than regular yakisoba.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I wonder if the other food stalls share the same phenomenon… Gulp…

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Attendant
text_block_list.text: Come one, come all! Help your digestion along with a little target practice at the shooting gallery, and win some fabulous prizes while you're at it!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Attendant
text_block_list.text: The nigh-unobtainable grand prize is a take-all-you-want ticket! You'll be sure to please that special someone at your side!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, since you resolved my empty stomach dilemma, I would like to request permission to grant your desires next.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: This shooting gallery seems to have the perfect prize that will let me show you my gratitude.
choice_data_list: Shall we give it a shot, then?
Shall we give it a shot, then?
Nah, let's try all the other food instead.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: This shooting gallery seems to have the perfect prize that will let me show you my gratitude.
choice_data_list: Shall we give it a shot, then?
Shall we give it a shot, then?
Nah, let's try all the other food instead.

text_block_list.text: She starts shooting in an attempt to win the grand prize, but…

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Aw, missed again. She's failed ten times, but she's still not giving up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Adjusting range by five millimeters. Adding three degrees to firing angle… Recalculating trajectory…
choice_data_list: It'll be curfew soon, so we'd better start heading home.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Understood. I have no issue. Because the next shot will be the last.
Bang! Thunk.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Target destroyed.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Whoooa! She totally called that one!

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Attendant
text_block_list.text: Haha! Looks like it's your victory, young lady! Take as many prizes as you want!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Very well, then. Master, what would you like?
choice_data_list: Pick whatever you want, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Whatever I want?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. Please wait.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I selected matching items that I think are perfect for us. Here.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I hope it fits your hand.
I remove the prize from the box and gently hold it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: What do you think? It's a hand grip. How does it feel?
choice_data_list: Um… good?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Excellent. Now we can train and improve together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Mission complete.
We return to the academy while working out with our matching hand grips.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That is only what I desire, and thus, it will only benefit me… It is no way to thank you.
choice_data_list: Whatever makes you happy makes me happy.
Whatever makes you happy makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: You want to see me happy…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. I will eat with all my might if that is what you wish.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Commencing food stall conquest. Let's start with that taiyaki stall.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: Wh-what is it?
Wh-what is it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Report—flavors are beyond expected levels, resulting in a short-circuit in my thought process.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I am unable to identify any special cooking techniques or seasoning used… This must be an ordinary taiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Similar to the yakisoba, its deliciousness perplexes me. Why does eating it make me feel so elated?
choice_data_list: Maybe because you're having fun?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see. I have seen data on this before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Feelings and flavor can operate together. I believe the words were "happiness is the best seasoning."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Let us have okonomiyaki next. I am intrigued as to whether it will surpass my expectations as well.
We continue ordering from the food stalls.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Burp… Consumption of cotton candy complete.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: We've visited every stall, and my energy levels are fully replenished.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: What about you, Master? Did the experience meet your expectations?
choice_data_list: Of course! I had a lot of fun!
Of course! I had a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Then my mission is complete. Currently saving this experience to my memory logs.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Recording today's events along with all the various culinary experiences that I enjoyed with you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I feel like if I access these logs, I'll be able to run up the steepest incline indefinitely.
Today's food doesn't only replenish Mihono Bourbon's energy levels, but also fills her heart with joy.
